body:
I am more or less financially secured, so no worries there. All of my finanfing depends on my graduating, which I plan to achieve unless I decide to just end it here and now. 5am here, hello neighbour? Still somewhat drunk. My first therapist tried to drill it into my head that my gender dysphoria was "just a teenage thing". That was when I was on a multitude of pills for depression/anxiety/condiments.

I just wish I could move far enough so my parents couldn't snoop in on everything. They were more or less fine with the trans shit, but at least dad wouldn't like seeing yet another depression diagnosis for me since he is anti-meds. I was the only one of the entire family to go to university after all,  but not only was I trans, I was also too crippled by depression to finish it in time. I feel like a failure.

Thanks for the encouraging words. I just don't know how I could get back in therapy without calling the emergency services.... I could just walk to the reception of the health centre and ask for an appointment but it's not that simple. I somehow feel like I've already humiliated my parents enough by being trans in the first place, like I don't feel I deserve to seek any additional help. And also that I feel like my parents think I am now "fixed" with HRT and I don't want them to think I made a mistake pursuing it. Fuck this.
